modules.description: Cultivate active wild yeast starters, understand hydration ratios, and control autolyse times.

modules.title: Module 2: Croissant Dough Lamination & Butter Blocks
modules.description: Create perfect 27-layer butter laminations for flaky, honeycomb-interior French croissants.

modules.title: Module 3: Delicate French Macarons Italian Method
modules.description: Whip glossy Italian meringue, fold almond flour macaronage, and bake feet-perfect shells.

modules.title: Module 4: Silky Ganaches, Pralines & Fruit Curds
modules.description: Emulsify chocolate ganaches, make crunchy hazelnut praline, and cook tart passion fruit curds.

modules.title: Module 5: Tart Construction & Gourmet Pastry Glazing
modules.description: Blind bake crisp pate sablee tart shells, pipe mousse domes, and pour mirror glazes.

description: Discover the precise chemistry and artistry of French patisserie and wild yeast baking. Create flaky laminated croissants, crusty sourdough loaves, and flawless macarons.
Learn temperature control, gluten development, and delicate pastry assembly.
keyPoints: Wild Sourdough Starter Maintenance and Fermentation
Laminated Butter Dough and Flaky Croissant Layers
Artisanal Bread Scoring and Steam Baking

lessonsList.title: The Art of Butter Lamination & Croissants
Perfect Macaron Shells and Rich Fillings
